controls.name: spread
controls.doc: The chorus's right-leg phase offset, in TURNS of its one oscillator. The right leg's voice k reads the LFO at k/N + spread: 0 is both legs one phase (the stage without the field, bit for bit), 0.25 quadrature, 0.5 the Dimension's opposed sweep. A fraction of a cycle carries no engineering symbol, so the unit is ''.

controls.name: rate
controls.doc: The chorus sweep's speed. Above ~3 Hz it stops being a chorus and becomes a vibrato.

controls.name: depth
controls.doc: The chorus's peak-to-peak excursion above its declared 10 ms base.

controls.name: voices
controls.doc: The chorus's tap count — one oscillator read at k/N.

controls.name: mix
controls.doc: The chorus's wet/dry, as an instance of DRIVE_MIX_RANGE — the same percent travel, its own come-up value: 35 %, a colour under the dry on a strip. The REVERB_LOWCUT_RANGE-over- REVERB_CUT_RANGE shape: one travel, one declared default per field that reads it.

CHORUS_BASE_MS.doc: The chorus's base delay, ms: the voices swing around it by up to the depth.

CHORUS_MAX_MS.doc: The longest delay a chorus voice reaches, rounded up to whole ms: the base delay plus the depth maximum. The delay line is sized from it.
